message.reasoning:
We need to process according to rules.

We have 5 orders, and 5 statement lines all payments (no refunds). Each with unique e2e_id, each linked via txid to order.

Check any duplicates none.

Now determine status per order.

We must compare amount received (gross) vs order amount, and timing vs expires_at.

All payments exactly match order amounts? Let's check:

PED-17524 amount 1244.82 payment 1244.82 at 11:22, expires at 11:47, time earlier => on time. So status could be paid.

PED-72111 amount 72.64 payment at 13:23, expires at 13:37 (since order expires 13:37). Payment is before expires_at (13:23 < 13:37) => on time. So paid.

PED-89243 amount 2404.93 payment at 10:59, expires at 11:06, before => on time. Paid.

PED-24660 amount 1400.05 payment at 14:48, expires at 14:57, before => on time. Paid.

PED-78342 amount 2304.91 payment at 12:59, expires at 13:21, before => on time. Paid.

All exactly match amounts, single payments each.

Now status selection order: unpaid, refunded, underpaid, overpaid, late_paid, paid. Since they meet paid condition, and earlier ones don't apply, status = "paid".

No refunds.

Payments list for each order: distinct e2e_ids linked, including refunds (none). So list containing the single e2e_id.

Orphans: need distinct e2e_ids of payment lines that cannot be linked to any order. All are linked, so none. Orphans empty array.

Now produce JSON:

 "orders": {
   "PED-24660": {"status":"paid","payments":["E3553119510001"]},

   "PED-17524": {"status":"paid","payments":["E1040184300005"]},
   "PED-78342": {"status":"paid","payments":["E1470021760003"]}
 },
 "orphans": []
}

Make sure ordering of keys not required, but produce as above.
